detector: T1 band-energy excess: 10 log10(E_W / median E_W), Butterworth 4-pole zero-phase 5-40 Hz, 1 s step; alarms declustered (runs closer than W are one alarm)

H01W.basis: T1 band-energy excess 5-40 Hz, W 30 s, arrival 90 % duration 15 s. Thresholds from empirical alarm rates in open raw IMS data, March 2015-2019, 00:00-04:00 UTC (113 days). P_D from injection of the shared source-model signal into the same data (each injection alone). SNR is relative to the local median window energy, so sigma_db is the detector term only; the user adds noise_sd_db and the propagation sd. Noise level: 8 Mar 2014 preferred 5-40 Hz level 104.28 dB re 1 uPa (p10 102.88, p90 105.88), minus 0.60 dB to convert mean power to the median 30 s window energy (offset measured on March 2015-2019 Cape Leeuwin data, median 103.17 dB).

IMOS3250.basis: T1 in each 307 s record, noise reference = median window energy over the record and its neighbours (15 min either side). False-alarm rate per CLOCK day (recorded fraction 0.339). Null: IMOS background 1-15 Mar 2014 (no 8 Mar) + event-day files outside 7 Mar 23:00-8 Mar 07:30 UTC. Noise level = median 30 s window level of the same records (5-40 Hz, system gain and sensitivity applied; 8 Hz hardware high-pass inside the band). Missing records are missing data, not non-detections.

OHASISBIO_MAD.basis: Published Royer 2016 Table 5 picks (detected = a pick is listed). One curve for all OHASISBIO sites, fitted with per-event source levels (prior sd 20 dB) and the Cape Leeuwin injection curve as the only absolute anchor; frozen-chain Royer loss table (10 m source, shared source shape). Noise level = Royer figure colour reading (not calibrated). The picks have no false-alarm rate. PROVISIONAL and not usable as a likelihood: post hoc refit without 9 paths of effective loss > 160 dB gives snr50 27.9 dB, sigma (incl. propagation) 20.0 dB. Royer events were selected by detection at 6 or more stations.

notes: P_D = pd_floor + (1 - pd_floor) Phi((SNR - snr50_db)/sigma_db). SNR_dB = 10 log10(E_s / N_W): E_s = total 5-40 Hz band energy of the arrival, N_W = noise energy level in a W-s window (median window energy). For a predicted SNR from a nominal noise level, use SNR = received band SEL - (noise_level_db + 10 log10 W) and add noise_sd_db and the propagation sd in quadrature to sigma_db. Primary: W 30 s, arrival 90 % duration 15 s; variants W10/30/60 x D15/60. Thresholds include all real transients (earthquake T-phases, ice, whales, airgun surveys); known-event association is not applied. OHASISBIO_* entries: picks data form from the Royer 2016 test; curve not identified (see basis).
